description: This Java class provides utility functions related to SEO URL processing, such as replacing special characters in URLs and removing contextual path segments from URIs.

classes.name: SeoUrlUtil
classes.description: A utility class for SEO URL processing, including methods to sanitize URLs and remove context paths.

methods.name: replaceSpecialCharsUrl
methods.description: Replaces special characters in a URL string based on character filters obtained from SeoConfigUtil.

methods.name: removeContextPath
methods.description: Removes the specified context path from the URI if present.
